### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A/P-Section]: Limit diagnoses and assessments strictly to those explicitly stated or confirmed by the provider in the transcript; do not infer or add speculative conditions.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A/P-Section]: Strictly adhere to the provider's explicit diagnoses and assessments; do not infer common conditions (e.g., URI) even if symptoms are consistent, especially when the provider states a different or more specific assessment (e.g., COVID-19 risk).
